parameters.name: plugin_bin
parameters.description: Specify logstash-plugin to use for plugin management. Default: "/usr/share/logstash/bin/logstash-plugin"

parameters.name: proxy_host
parameters.description: Proxy host to use during plugin installation.

parameters.name: proxy_port
parameters.description: Proxy port to use during plugin installation.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Specify version of the plugin to install. If the plugin exists with a previous version, it is not updated.

examples:
- name: Install Logstash beats input plugin
  community.general.logstash_plugin:
    state: present
    name: logstash-input-beats

- name: Install specific version of a plugin
  community.general.logstash_plugin:
    state: present
    name: logstash-input-syslog
    version: '3.2.0'

- name: Uninstall Logstash plugin
  community.general.logstash_plugin:
    state: absent
    name: logstash-filter-multiline

- name: Install Logstash plugin with alternate heap size
  community.general.logstash_plugin:
    state: present
    name: logstash-input-beats
  environment:
    LS_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms256m -Xmx256m"
